transport.address_rule: http://${EXAMPLE_RETRIEVAL_REPO_HTTP_HOST:-127.0.0.1}:${EXAMPLE_RETRIEVAL_REPO_HTTP_PORT:-8767}/mcp (example_retrieval_repo_mcp/http_config.py); env vars unset on this box, default answered

project_binding.outside_registered_repo: no refusal at the transport: project_list_sources answered ok with resolution.git_root = another repo (example-retrieval-repo's checkout) and not_indexed_reason = boot_fallback_ambiguous; project_doc_links answered verdict source_unspecified (data empty, hint lists addressable repos). The caller must therefore compare identity_field to its own repo root before trusting any other answer.

transport.auth: none on loopback: no header or token sent beyond Content-Type: application/json and Accept: application/json, text/event-stream
transport.framing: POST /mcp, JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/call, stateless (no session id); reply is text/event-stream with one 'data: {json}' line whose result.content[0].text is the tool envelope as a JSON string
transport.daemon_down: connection refused (URLError, WinError 10061), observed against an unbound loopback port; the live shared daemon was not stopped
transport.daemon_warming: not measured: producing it needs a restart of the shared daemon (GET /health reported status=ready, boot_complete=true throughout); the plan's 503 reading is unconfirmed

system-map.reason: names only: data.systems[] entries carry {name} and no file_count or line_count in the answer for this repo; the system names are rag's top-level-directory set (11), not the atlas's

edges.reason: static module-level imports only (data.limits.excludes); same single call as system-map

file-index.reason: no door returns per-file rows with a system: the graph returns counts and a boundary-citation file list, project_code_outline is per file, project_records_query reads declared structured-records sources only

dead-paths.reason: one call per atlas page (23 system pages and 4 top-level pages); resolution is target_missing | unresolved | ambiguous | resolved, so a dead path is target_missing or unresolved; the answer names no last-touching commit

last-touch.reason: no door returns the last commit that touched a path

l2_structural.note: stamps are keyed by branch name with a +dirty suffix; the live branch is work/machine-a/2026-10-04to12, so no stamp is keyed to it. Stamp date 2026-10-06T05:04:46+01:00 agrees with the structural index age the graph envelope reports (provenance.index_age_seconds.project_structural_index = 552039 at the first call).

project_staleness_check.reason: l2.computed false, degraded_reason internal_budget_exceeded on every sample (about 5.0s)

project_architecture_graph.reason: an age in seconds, no commit; provenance.serving_commit (9b59cce63) is the daemon's code commit and is not recorded as the index commit

l3_text.note: embedding layer, not the structure's commit; l3.refresh.code has no stamp
